title: The pull requests on the repos prs reads
description: What `prs list --json` prints, and `pull_requests` and `recently_closed` in `prs tui --json`: one object per pull request, and [] where there are none. `prs list --json` and `pull_requests` list the open ones a person opened, then those an app opened, each oldest first. `recently_closed` lists those merged or closed within the --since window, newest first. Every field is always present. A field the provider's listing does not carry is null rather than a zero, so a pull request nobody counted never reads as one that changed nothing.

provider.description: Who hosts it. Every action but the local diff dispatches on it.

repo.description: The repository's bare name, which is only a label, since two repositories can share one.

slug.description: owner/name, which identifies the repository. A Bitbucket owner is the project key.

author.description: The login that opened it, and empty for a deleted account.

bot.description: True where the provider says an app opened it, and null where its listing does not say.

body.description: The description as markdown, and empty where it has none.

additions.description: Null, never 0, where the listing does not count it.

deletions.description: Null, never 0, where the listing does not count it.

changed_files.description: Null, never 0, where the listing does not count it.

review.description: The provider's review decision, such as APPROVED, and empty until a review is requested.

reviews.description: How many reviews were submitted, which a review setting no decision still counts.

checks.description: The head commit's check rollup, such as SUCCESS, and empty until a workflow runs.

age_days.description: Whole days since it was opened.

path.description: Where its repository is checked out on this machine, and empty where it is not.

state.description: OPEN, MERGED or CLOSED on GitHub, and bbkt's word on Bitbucket.

closed_at.description: Null until it closes, which a merge also does.

updated_at.description: Null where the listing does not carry it.

mergeable.description: GitHub's MERGEABLE, CONFLICTING or UNKNOWN, which reads UNKNOWN until GitHub has computed it, and null where the listing does not carry it.

merge_state_status.description: GitHub's merge state, such as CLEAN, BEHIND, BLOCKED, DIRTY or UNKNOWN, and null where the listing does not carry it.

in_merge_queue.description: Null where the listing does not carry it.

head_oid.description: The head commit's full hash, and null where the listing does not carry it.

stacked_on.description: The number of the open pull request in the same repository whose branch this one merges into, and null where it merges into no open one's.
